title: Test Summary reads a macOS job GitHub never ran (abandoned, no runner) as FAILED, like a failing test
body:
## Problem

The v0.1.15 tag's Devbin Tests run 40373607694 (4efb6e17) went red on Test Summary alone. Its macOS job never started: GitHub's annotation reads "The job was not acquired by Runner of type hosted even after multiple attempts", beside its notices that macOS arm64 runners are short of capacity. Ubuntu, WSL and ShellCheck passed. The summary step printed `test-macos = 'abandoned'` and then `FAILED: test-macos`, the same line a failing test prints, so a run that GitHub never ran read as a devbin failure. hv read it that way (2026-10-26).

`abandoned` is the result GitHub's `needs` context gives a job no runner took. Its documentation lists only success, failure, cancelled and skipped.

## Fix

The summary keeps its verdict, since a required leg with no verdict is still not a pass, and splits its line. A leg whose result is `abandoned` goes on its own line, `NOT RUN: <legs> -- GitHub acquired no runner, so no step ran and no test failed; re-run the failed jobs once a runner is free`, and `FAILED:` names only the legs that ran and failed. The step exits 1 if either line prints.

## Done when

- The summary prints `NOT RUN:` for each `abandoned` leg, and `FAILED:` only for the others; it exits 1 when either is non-empty.
- ci-workflow.bats runs the real script on an abandoned macOS leg on a tag (NOT RUN, no FAILED line), on an abandoned leg beside a failed one (both lines), and on an abandoned leg where macOS is not required (still NOT RUN); every existing arm is unchanged.
- Red on main: the new arms fail on main. The field red is run 40373607694, cited.
- Green at the fix under BSD and GNU: ci-workflow.bats and every tree-scan file, found by population, plus help.bats.
- Landed and pushed by vc; CI green on the new head.

## Resolution

Fixed at 22fcf435, built and landed by vc. Test Summary's script in .github/workflows/tests.yml now passes each red leg through one function, refuse, which puts a leg whose result is `abandoned` on its own `NOT RUN:` line, saying that GitHub acquired no runner, so no step ran and no test failed, and that the failed jobs can be re-run once a runner is free. Every other red result stays on the `FAILED:` line. The step prints both lines when both hold and exits 1 when either does, since a required leg with no verdict is no pass.

- **Done when 1.** `NOT RUN:` names each abandoned leg and `FAILED:` only the others, and the step exits 1 when either is non-empty: the summary step's refuse function and its closing lines in tests.yml.
- **Done when 2.** tests/unit/ci-workflow.bats's arm "the summary names a leg GitHub abandoned as NOT RUN, never as FAILED, and still refuses (0238)" runs the real script on an abandoned macOS leg on a tag (NOT RUN, no FAILED line), on an abandoned macOS leg where macOS is not required (still NOT RUN, still a refusal), and on an abandoned leg beside a failed Ubuntu leg (both lines). The diff adds that arm and changes no existing one.
- **Done when 3.** The field red is Devbin Tests run 40373607694 on the v0.1.15 tag (4efb6e17), attempts 1 and 2, whose summary printed `FAILED: test-macos` for a macOS job GitHub never acquired. On main, the new arm failed at its first assertion, the summary printing no `NOT RUN:` line (the arm on main's script, red238 at 893ceb9d).
- **Done when 4.** At the fix, each file alone, under BSD and then GNU: ci-workflow.bats, help.bats and every file that scans the tree, found by searching tests/unit for the scan helpers rather than from a list (config, documentation, contract, dispatch, harness, helpers, lineendings, installhints, install, neutral, readonlygit, releasecut, updatenotice, workroom), plus vendoredmd. Every TAP ran to its plan with nothing failed, and the only skips were harness.bats's `require_command` arms and install.bats's case-sensitive-disk arm, which skip by design on this Mac. The runs went one at a time in light slot 01M5WSYG7B9STDAFMTKMER6ND1, from 2026-10-26 19:11:45Z to 19:42:24Z, the driver ending with rc 0 (~/Devel/scratch/devbin-vc/st0010/land238).
- **Done when 5.** Landed and pushed by vc on hv's "Just ship it", 4efb6e17..22fcf435 to local and upstream, read back at 19:39:40Z. By then every BSD file had passed, and GNU's had through readonlygit; GNU's releasecut, updatenotice, workroom and vendoredmd passed after the push, by 19:42:24Z. CI run 40388712863 on 22fcf435 is green: Test on Ubuntu, Shell Script Analysis and Test Summary passed, the summary printing "All required checks passed." with macOS not required on a push; both plans ran in full with no failing test, and its skips are the same as those of run 40349359447, the last green before it.
